title: Understated Garlicky Norwegian Fish Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful Norwegian fish stew featuring a garlicky mirepoix base and low sodium fish sauce, served in a tagliere vessel.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: low sodium chicken or fish broth optional

instructions: Rinse the cod fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and set aside.
Heat a large tagliere vessel over medium heat, adding the minced garlic and cooking until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots, celery, and onions, cooking until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, water, and black pepper, stirring to combine and bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Add the cod fillets to the stew, covering the vessel and cooking for an additional 8 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with additional black pepper if needed.
Serve the stew hot, with lemon wedges on the side if desired.
Let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
